svg.title: Substitute each value into the cubic and quintic, then return the result to the graph
svg.desc: Starting at 0.1, iteration 12. The cubic receives 1.000000 and returns 1.000000. The quintic receives 0.703558 and returns 1.110680. Both substitutions and their numerical terms are shown beside the trace.
svg.text: Return each result to the graph
Substitutions are rounded; the recurrence uses full precision.
